name: Frederique di Parisi
source:
“I am your man to the last, sister.”
Your brother and best friend. He’s a bit lazy and a troublemaker, but he is loyal and will help in any way he can – whether he agrees or not.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?t=40623]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
